Computational analysis via DharmaNexus indicates extensive textual reuse across the Pali Abhidhamma, recording over 10,000 matching segments across 99 Pali texts [DharmaNexus]. The vast majority of these correspondences represent formulaic combinations shared with other divisions of the *Paṭṭhāna*, most notably the *Kusalattika* (Patthana 1.2), *Piṭṭhiduka* (Patthana 2.13), *Mahantaraduka* (Patthana 2.10), and *Kilesagocchaka* (Patthana 2.12) [DharmaNexus].
